root.description: The id of the root the paths are under

config.description: The demanded config, relative to its root

ordinal.description: 0-based position of the target among the pattern's targets

target.description: The target as written, relative to `basePath`

basePath.description: The directory the targets resolve from (the `baseUrl` when set, else the directory of the config that set `paths`), relative to the root; `.` for the root

projection-tsconfig-paths.description: A row of the derived `tsconfig_paths` relation
